text:
BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature
Description
This iRules command returns the name of the detected Bot Signature, or
an empty string if no bot signature was detected.
Syntax
BOTDEFENSE
::
bot_signature
Examples
# EXAMPLE: Log the bot signature.
when
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST
{
set
log
"botdefense bot_signature is"
append
log
" [BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature]"
HSL
::
send
$hsl
$log
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST, BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
